system.name: ModelKeeper
system.one_liner: a system that accelerates DNN training by warming up new training jobs with weights transformed from previously trained zoo models

components.name: Query Model
components.role: small dataflow-graph example whose tensor nodes index the columns of the similarity table

components.name: Parent Model
components.role: small dataflow-graph example (a zoo model) whose tensor nodes index the rows of the similarity table

components.name: M(|gp|+1)x(|gq|+1)
components.role: dynamic-programming similarity table recording the best matching score after aligning prefixes of the parent and query models

components.name: SKIP_PARENT
components.role: table transition that skips the current parent-model node without matching it

components.name: SKIP_CHILD
components.role: table transition that skips the current query-model node without matching it

components.name: MATCH
components.role: table transition that matches a parent-model node to a query-model node, highlighted as the transition achieving the maximum score

components.name: End-to-end similarity
components.role: final bottom-right cell of the table giving the overall similarity between the full parent and query models

flows.what: query-model node indices used as column headers
parent-model node indices used as row headers
topological traversal of the table accumulating the best match score

content.key_idea: ModelKeeper measures graph-level model similarity with a DP table over parent/query tensor pairs, choosing at each cell the best of matching the pair, skipping the parent node, or skipping the query node.
content.reading_order: From the small Query Model and Parent Model graphs at top and left, into the DP grid they index, following the color-coded SKIP_PARENT, SKIP_CHILD, and MATCH annotations toward the End-to-end similarity cell at bottom-right.

palette.used_for: light gray fill of the DP-matrix cells
dark gray text for matrix values and grid labels
near-white alternate cell fill in the matrix grid
magenta text and arrow for the SKIP_CHILD annotation
blue text and column highlight for the SKIP_PARENT annotation

style.stroke: thin solid gray grid lines (~0.5pt) with one column shaded blue to highlight a transition
style.font: mixed serif/sans, Times New Roman body text with GillSans-SemiBold labels, 4-6.5pt with some 12pt emphasis text
style.arrows: many curved and straight colored arrows annotating specific matrix transitions and the small DAG edges

encoding.color_means: blue = SKIP_PARENT transition, magenta = SKIP_CHILD transition, green = the MATCH transition achieving the maximum score, orange = the end-to-end similarity result cell
encoding.line_style_means: arrows trace specific transitions through the DP table (skip-parent moves along one axis, skip-child along the other, match moves diagonally), overlaid on the small Query/Parent Model graphs whose circled nodes index the table
encoding.emphasis: colored text and arrows pick out one example cell/transition of each of the three DP operations directly on the table, plus a highlighted final cell for the end-to-end similarity score
reusable_patterns: dynamic-programming table walkthrough with color-coded example transitions
small node-link diagrams used as row/column headers indexing a matrix
weaknesses: dense grid of numeric values in small fonts may be hard to read at reduced size
several overlapping colored annotations require careful visual disentangling

evidence: ModelKeeper relies on dynamic programming-like heuristics to measure graph-level model architectural similarity.
Figure 7 shows the execution of our structure-aware matching algorithm.

summary: This figure illustrates ModelKeeper's structure-aware pairwise model matching, the dynamic-programming heuristic used to measure graph-level architectural similarity between a Query Model being trained and a Parent Model from ModelKeeper's zoo. Small dataflow graphs of each model, with circled tensor-node indices, index the rows (Parent Model) and columns (Query Model) of a similarity table M(|gp|+1)x(|gq|+1) that records the best similarity after matching prefixes of the two graphs. Color-coded annotations on the grid mark the three transitions considered when filling each cell: SKIP_PARENT (blue) skips a parent node, SKIP_CHILD (magenta) skips a query node, and MATCH (green) pairs specific nodes, here shown as the transition achieving the maximum score. An orange annotation marks the End-to-end similarity result in the table's final cell. The figure is a dense grid of numeric values with curved, colored arrows overlaying both the small model graphs and the table itself.
summary_zh: 该图展示ModelKeeper的结构感知模型匹配算法：用动态规划相似度表比较父模型与查询模型的张量图，蓝色SKIP_PARENT、品红SKIP_CHILD、绿色MATCH标注具体转移，橙色标出端到端相似度结果格。
notes: The exact node indices in the figure's small 'MATCH(...)' annotation were not fully legible at the rendered resolution, so the record describes the MATCH/SKIP_PARENT/SKIP_CHILD operations generally rather than asserting specific numbers, beyond the paragraph's own (2→3)-to-(2→3) branch-matching example near table position (6,6).
